import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/training_3.csv"
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
source_dfs = [pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0) for file in source_files]

# According to operation_history, perform UNION of all source tables
# All source tables have the same schema ['WarNum', 'WhereFought'], so union is valid
target_df = pd.concat(source_dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the target schema and types are correct
target_df = target_df.astype({'WarNum': 'int64', 'WhereFought': 'int64'})

# Write the result to the target path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# UNION all source tables
union_df = pd.concat([source0, source1, source2, source3], ignore_index=True)

# GROUP BY WarNum and aggregate WhereFought by MIN to enforce functional dependency and uniqueness
result = union_df.groupby("WarNum", as_index=False).agg({"WhereFought": "min"})

# Write the final output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
